english: Sarihaddhulu leyni saasvatha premanu naapai choopaavu
avadhulu leyni aanandhamutho anudhinamu sthuthi paadedha
Unnatha sthalamulalo nannu nadipinchey needhu sankalpamu

intro: Sarihaddhulu Leni Prema is the latest Telugu Christmas song written, tuned and produced by Pr.William Carey & Esther, sung by Lillyan Christopher and music composed by renowned Telugu Christian music director, J K Christopher. This song video was released on January 03, 2024 through JK Christopher YouTube Channel.
